x: A Club mile handicap saw Boreham, Dooley and Reeves take the awards in that order. A team walk of two miles gave Belgrave a win over the Met.
This is, whatever the unitiated may think, an extremely difficult and energetic task and our reward is in the knowledge that nobody (perhaps Dooley would prefer me to say no visitor) went off course.
The Juniors repeated their score in the 880 yds. but in the Senior event the Herne Hill men were too strong for our two, Dooley and Fox, and so went ahead on points.
Our other men however, were making little or no improvement with the exception of J.Dooley who had started very slowly and was now beginning his late excursion through the field.
